newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine property stock index falls 7.31 pct.
newsitem.headline: Philippine property stock index falls 7.31 pct.

text.p: The Philippine property stock index dropped steeply by 7.31 percent, or 101.58 points, to 1,287.43 at midsession due to fears of a real estate crash, traders said.

Despite assurances by the industry and Philippine government officials, foreign investors still believe the local property sector is heading for troubled times, said Liza Joson, research head at Amsteel Securities.

Mass housing builder Empire East Land Holdings Inc lost 5.56 percent, or 30 centavos, to 5.10 pesos while its parent Megaworld Holdings and Properties Inc lost 8.33 percent, or 50 centavos, to 5.50 pesos.
Filinvest Land Inc fell 8.82 percent, or 60 centavos, to 6.20 pesos while SM Prime Holdings lost 6.85 percent, or 50 centavos, to 6.80 pesos.
